mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(p.pass_id) FROM operator_data_pass p LEFT JOIN operators o ON p.operator_id = o.operator_id

SELECT p.pass_id AS passId, p.company_id AS companyId, p.operator_id AS operatorId, p.status AS status, p.is_closed AS isClosed, p.start_time AS startTime, p.end_time AS endTime, p.rule AS rule, p.reason AS reason, p.remarks AS remarks, p.create_time AS createTime, p.approve_time AS approveTime, p.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.login_name AS loginName, o.head_portrait AS headPortrait, o.operator_type AS operatorType FROM operator_data_pass p LEFT JOIN operators o ON p.operator_id = o.operator_id
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
